title: Power-series rings over fields or Cohen rings are adically formally smooth over the prime ring
statement: Let $n\ge0$. If $K$ is a field of characteristic zero and $S=K[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], then $S$ is formally smooth over $\mathbf Q$ for its maximal-ideal-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. If $K$ is a field of characteristic $p>0$ and $S=K[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$, then $S$ is formally smooth over $\mathbf F_p$ for its maximal-ideal-adic topology. If $\Lambda$ is a Cohen ring with maximal ideal $p\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $S=\Lambda[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$, then $S$ is formally smooth over $\mathbf Z$ for its maximal-ideal-adic topology (the maximal ideal being $(p,X_1,\ldots,X_n)$).

proof.text: For clause (2), unfold [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic] and fix a square-zero test ideal J in an F_p-algebra D, a map g, and an exponent k whose variable-ideal power g kills. The quotient map [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient] is surjective, so choose lifts d_i of g(X_i). Because X_i^k belongs to the k-th variable-ideal power, g(X_i)^k=0 and d_i^k belongs to J. Thus d_i^(2k)=0. Mathlib Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical and Submodule.fg_span show that a=span(range d) is nilpotent. They also show b=span(range (g(X_i))) is nilpotent, using g(X_i)^k=0. For any ideal c with c^N=0, the IsHausdorff condition follows by evaluating at N; a Cauchy sequence f converges to f(N), since the congruence at N is equality for every later term and compatibility gives the congruences for earlier terms. This proves [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] for both ideals. Finite ranges include the empty range when n=0, with no nontriviality assumption on D.

proof.text: The F_p-algebra structure on D implies p=0 in D by applying its structure map to p=0 in ZMod p. Apply RingHom.exists_lift_of_field_charP [lem-weil-pbc-field-char-p-nilpotent-lifting] with N=2 to g composed with the constant-series inclusion, obtaining a coefficient ring map h:K→D whose reduction is that restriction of g.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NL (lemma-power-series-ring-over-Cohen-fs), all three clauses and proof using Algebra Proposition Tag 0322 and Lemma Tag 0329

proof.text: Apply MvPowerSeries.exists_ringHom_of_isAdicComplete [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-universal-property-complete] over (D,a) to h and d_i to obtain f. Apply the same theorem over (D/J,b) to the coefficient restriction of g and g(X_i). Its uniqueness clause identifies both q composed with f and g with the supplied map, because their constant and variable images agree. Convert f to an F_p-algebra homomorphism: every element of ZMod p is an integer cast, and ring maps preserve integer casts. Extensionality gives equality of the algebra-homomorphism composite and g, supplying the lift in [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic].
